name: Natsu Doki!
source:
Shinichi visits his grandparents on the countryside. There he meets a sickly ojousama, Asami, and got reacquainted with a girl he doesn't recall so well, Mari. 

What he thought to be a calm romantic summer vacation turns out to be a shameful erotic mishap when a mischievous girl pulled a prank on him. He's tricked to eat a mushroom that causes him to have erection round the clock.

Shinichi the erection prince, as townsfolk calls him, swore vengeance. But first of all, he has to calm his penis down.
translation:
真一来到乡下探望祖父母。在那里，他遇见了体弱多病的大小姐樱泽亚纱美，也与一个自己记不太清的女孩茉莉重逢。

他原以为这会是一场平静而浪漫的暑假，却因淘气女孩对他恶作剧而变成了可耻的色情闹剧。他被骗着吃下一种蘑菇，结果整天都保持着勃起。

镇民称他为“勃起王子”的真一发誓要复仇。不过在那之前，他得先让自己的老二安静下来。
